name: airo
description: Read shared Airo air readings and history through the hosted Airo MCP service. Each tool result identifies live or simulated data.

interface.shortDescription: Read shared Airo air readings with your AI.
interface.longDescription: Connect Airo to Codex, enter your separately supplied share token in the browser, review the shared devices, and allow read-only access. This internal preview connects to the shared HTTPS Airo service; no local backend is required. The configured backend supplies live Console shared readings or simulated data, identified in each tool result. It cannot change device settings.
